name: Yin Release Adept: Black Fang – Yin Palm Strike

system.description:
You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike with claws like a wolves jaw. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Yin Palm Strike.

Yin Palm Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, you inject Yin chakra into them, breaking their spiritual center, but marking them with a Yin-Seal.
